## Why visit

A particularly atmospheric November choice for people who like small traditional rooms, a fire and conversation. The three-room layout, old bar fittings and dense collection of First World War-era memorabilia create a highly individual pub near the city walls. Its value is very different from That Beer Place: come here for a quiet traditional setting and a cask pint, with home cooking a useful bonus. The main planning constraint is its deliberately restricted opening pattern. Build a visit around a confirmed session rather than assuming continuous all-day service.
